completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Darjah Utama Bakti Cemerlang (Tentera) —
(The Distinguished Service Order — Military)
Rules 1981
It is hereby notified for general information that the President having been pleased to approve the institution of an Order to be styled the Darjah Utama Bakti Cemerlang (Tentera) or “the Distinguished Service Order (Military)” hereby makes the following Rules:
[S 208/2005 wef 04/04/2005]
